paper_title: Effect of Branched Alkyl Chains Attached at sp3 Silicon of Donor-Acceptor Copolymers on Their Morphology and Photovoltaic Properties
source_file: /home/wzfeng/MySearch/PhotoRag/MD/Journal of Polymer Science Part A  Polymer Chemistry - 2012 - Nakanishi - Effect of branched alkyl chains attached at sp3/auto/Journal of Polymer Science Part A  Polymer Chemistry - 2012 - Nakanishi - Effect of branched alkyl chains attached at sp3.md

knowledge_points.content: The study compares two donor-acceptor copolymers, PDTSi6-DTBTz (P1) and PDTSiEH-DTBTz (P2), which utilize dithienosilole (DTSi) as the donor and 4,7-dithienyl-2-octylbenzotriazole (DTBTz) as the acceptor unit.
knowledge_points.evidence: In this contribution, we used two donor-acceptor copolymers—PDTSi6-DTBTz and PDTSiEH-DTBTz—composed of dithienosiloles with hexyl (DTSi6) or 2-ethylhexyl (DTSiEH) groups at their sp3 silicons as donors and 4,7-dithienyl-2-octyl-[1,2,3]benzotriazole (DTBTz) as an acceptor.

knowledge_points.content: Branched 2-ethylhexyl groups attached to the sp3 silicon in PDTSiEH-DTBTz (P2) lead to stronger interchain interactions compared to the linear hexyl groups in PDTSi6-DTBTz (P1), as evidenced by a prominent shoulder peak at 615 nm in the solid-state absorption spectrum.
knowledge_points.evidence: The solid-state absorption spectra of the polymers reveal that P2 possesses stronger interchain interactions than P1... The P2 film showed absorption maxima at 576 and 615 nm.

knowledge_points.content: DFT calculations at the B3LYP/6-31G(d,p) level suggest that the 2-ethylhexyl group on the dithienosilole unit can adopt a conformation that does not interrupt pi-pi stacking, where the ethyl groups are positioned away from the pi-system.
knowledge_points.evidence: The obtained result indicates that P2 possesses intrinsically stronger interchain pi-pi interactions than P1... implying that pi-pi stacking of each polymer occurs without interruption by the ethyl groups and DTSiEH moiety in P2 is in Figure 3(c) conformation.

knowledge_points.content: The polymer with branched side chains (P2) exhibits a higher hole mobility of 9.7 x 10^-5 cm^2 V^-1 s^-1 compared to the linear side chain polymer (P1), which shows a mobility of 1.2 x 10^-5 cm^2 V^-1 s^-1 at room temperature.
knowledge_points.evidence: The field-effect hole mobility was calculated to be 9.7 x 10^-5 cm^2 V^-1 s^-1... The other hole mobilities obtained were 1.2 x 10^-5 cm^2 V^-1 s^-1 for P1 at RT.

knowledge_points.content: The exciton binding energy (Eb) is lower for the branched polymer P2 (0.49 eV) compared to the linear polymer P1 (0.54 eV), which is attributed to the increased interchain pi-pi interactions in the branched system.
knowledge_points.evidence: The small Eb of P2 (0.49 eV), compared to that of P1 (0.54 eV), can be attributed to the increased interchain pi-pi interactions in P2.

knowledge_points.content: The best organic photovoltaic (OPV) device based on PDTSiEH-DTBTz:PC70BM (P2) achieved a PCE of 2.03% with a Voc of 0.55 V, Jsc of 6.38 mA cm^-2, and FF of 0.54.
knowledge_points.evidence: The best PCEs from the cell annealed at RT reached up to... 2.03% with Jsc of 6.38 mA cm^-2, Voc of 0.55 V, and FF of 0.54 for P2.

knowledge_points.content: Thermal annealing at 110 °C disrupts the ordering structure in PDTSiEH-DTBTz (P2) films, leading to a decrease in the absorption intensity at 615 nm and a reduction in the overall power conversion efficiency (PCE).
knowledge_points.evidence: Heating of P2 increased the absorbance around 530 nm while decreasing the peak intensity at 615 nm... With increasing annealing temperature, the PCE decreased mainly because of the decrease in the FF, presumably because of the disordering of interpenetrating networks.

knowledge_points.content: AFM analysis shows that P2:PC70BM blend films have a significantly higher surface roughness (RMS = 1.29 nm) than P1:PC70BM films (RMS = 0.35 nm), indicating that the stronger pi-pi interactions in P2 lead to larger domain formation.
knowledge_points.evidence: The P1:PC70BM blend films at RT and 110 C exhibited smoother surfaces with root-mean-square (RMS) roughnesses of 0.35 and 0.33 nm... On the other hand, the P2:PC70BM blend films yielded slightly larger domains with RMS roughness of 1.29 nm at RT.

knowledge_points.content: Both P1 and P2 polymers show high thermal stability with 5% weight loss temperatures (Td) of 439 °C and 427 °C, respectively, as determined by thermogravimetric analysis (TGA).
knowledge_points.evidence: The TGA measurements revealed that the 5% weight loss temperatures (Td) of P1 and P2 were 439 and 427 C, respectively, showing good thermal stability of the polymers.

knowledge_points.content: The optimal active layer thickness for the PDTSi6-DTBTz:PC70BM (P1) system was found to be approximately 64 nm with a 1:1 weight ratio.
knowledge_points.evidence: The optimal blend ratio and film thickness for P1 were determined to be around 1:1 and 64 nm, respectively.
